facts.business: Golechha Global Finance Limited is a non-banking finance company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India, engaged in lending operations including retail loans and investment in shares of other companies.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The company anticipates steady growth in FY27, underpinned by expansion in loans and advances, alongside strategic investments in risk management, technology, and human capital.

auditor.name: V. Goyal & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualification, reservation or adverse remark in the Independent Auditors Report. Secretarial Audit noted non-compliance with RBI reporting timelines for DNBS02, DNBS13, DNBS10 returns.

key_risks: Rising unsecured loan exposure heightening credit risk
Liquidity constraints and price volatility contributing to market risk
Operational vulnerabilities in cybersecurity and digital fraud
Regulatory tightening under RBI's Upper Layer classification for large NBFCs
Global recessionary pressures impacting capital inflows
Volatility in equity markets and rising funding costs straining margins
Currency risks from offshore borrowing exposure
facts.related_party_note: The Company, being a non-banking finance Company registered with the Reserve Bank of India and engaged in the business of giving loans, is exempt from complying with the provisions of section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013. Accordingly, the disclosures of the loans given as required under the aforesaid section have not been given in this Report.
